title: Load alerts wake the Assistant when the Mac or Claude limits go red, without churn

requirements.text: A pure alert state machine in GenlockCore turns LoadReading/UsageReading streams into at most one alert per episode: sustain delay, hysteresis exit, per-metric 60-min cooldown, ~6/day cap, simultaneous metrics merged
requirements.check: swift test: unit tests feed synthetic readings and assert alerts fire once per episode, not on brief spikes or flapping, and respect cooldown and cap

requirements.text: When an alert fires the app opens the Assistant if it is not running and sends it one message: what went red, recent readings, top processes, and the ask to manage/pause/snooze
requirements.check: manual: force a threshold (test override), Assistant opens and receives exactly one message

requirements.text: The Assistant can snooze a metric until it clears (e.g. genlock command), and a snoozed metric raises no further alert
requirements.check: manual: snooze battery, keep it red, no second alert; it clears, then re-arms

requirements.text: Claude-limit alerts never start an Assistant: only an already-running one is told, otherwise a Mac notification
requirements.check: swift test or manual: limit alert with Assistant closed starts no session

requirements.text: Alerts have their own switch and are off whenever the load panel is off
requirements.check: manual: Session menu toggle; off -> no alerts

text: Edge-triggered alerts: one per episode, sustain delay, hysteresis, 60-min per-metric cooldown, ~6/day cap, merged message, Assistant snooze; limit alerts never spin up an Assistant
user_said: i dont want these hooks to cause constant agentic churn and analysis... staying in 'red alert zone' triggering the assisstant would just be waste

text: Thresholds (TJ said he does not know; mine): CPU >=90% 3min / clear <70% 5min; memory kernel level warning 2min or critical now / clear normal 5min; battery <=15% draining or draining on AC 10min / clear charging; 5h limit >=85% / clear on reset; weekly >=15 over pace / clear <=5
breaks: too tight churns the Assistant, too loose misses slowdowns; keep them in one table so they are easy to tune

text: Design agreed in chat (see decide/assume). Readings: GenlockCore/SystemLoad.swift (LoadReading, Codable), app LoadMonitor in GenlockApp/LoadPanel.swift (5s), usage in AppModel.usage (UsagePoller). Assistant: AppModel.openAssistant(), relayToAssistant() for message paths; genlock ask assistant (lib/ask.mjs). Build pure state machine first in GenlockCore with tests. Relaunch: my rm-based swap is blocked by safety check; TJ uses Restart to update.

evidence: app/Tests/GenlockCoreTests/LoadAlertsTests.swift: swift test --filter LoadAlertsTests -> 10 passed, 0 failures (once per episode over 30 min red; 2-min spikes never fire; 70-90 flapping one episode; 60-min cooldown; cap 6 per rolling day; merged cpu+memory; relaunch mid-episode no re-alert)

text: Wired: LoadMonitor feeds LoadAlerts each 5s tick + each usage poll (AppModel claudeTicker), state saved to voice/load-alerts.json on change; AppModel.tellAssistant (waits out a turn/dictation, starts Tally quietly only for machine alerts, else Notifier.postLoad); Session menu 'Turn Load Alerts Off/On'; genlock load [snooze|test METRIC] via voice/load-requests.json; app writes voice/load.json. 175 swift tests + npm test pass; build/Genlock.app built. Needs TJ's Restart to update, then live checks reqs 2-5.

why: alert state machine, thresholds table, message text

evidence: Live, new build: genlock load test cpu -> Tally transcript cea11119 got exactly 1 user message at 14:49:16Z '[Load alert (test)] CPU went red.' with CPU 70%/3-min avg 73%, top 5 processes, snooze command; load-requests.json consumed. (Tally was running; the closed-Tally path reuses the relays' quiet start with openingMessage.)

LoadAlertsTests.testSnoozeHoldsUntilClearThenRearms: snoozed battery kept red 48 min + brief plug-in -> no 2nd alert; charges 5 min -> snooze cleared, next low-drain episode alerts (2). testSnoozeWhileClearIsDroppedAtOnce. Live: genlock load snooze battery -> load-alerts.json battery snoozed:true within 7s (that live run exposed snooze-while-clear lingering; fixed). 14/14 pass.

LoadAlertsTests.testLimitAlertsNeverStartAnAssistant: LoadDelivery.decide(running:false, mayStart: !limitsOnly) for [session,weekly] -> .notify (Mac notification), running -> .submit; AppModel.tellAssistant routes through LoadDelivery.decide. 14/14 pass.

answers.absence: No real red episode has fired yet; closed-Tally quiet start and the limit Mac notification not seen live; alerts-off switch waived. One full-suite run under load ~46 had 1 unnamed failure, rerun clean
answers.assumption: Thresholds are mine (TJ did not know): CPU>=90 3min, memory warning 2min/critical now, battery<=15 draining, 5h>=85, weekly +15 over pace; cooldown 60min, cap 6/day
answers.falsify: Assistant receives a second alert within one red episode, or a limit alert starts Tally while it is closed
